summary.one_liner: An awesome-list of resources for the Flask Python micro web framework, covering its official docs, extensions, tutorials, books, talks, boilerplate projects and hosting options.
summary.what_it_does: This is a curated link list rather than a software project. It opens with official Flask resources (documentation, the Flaskr tutorial, Pallets-Eco, and Quart as an ASGI counterpart). The Extensions section is split into categories such as Admin, APIs, Auth, Cache, Databases, Developer Tools, Email, Forms and Validation, Full-text Search, Security, Task Queues and Utils, with one-line descriptions per entry. Resources lists community channels, tutorials, books, talks and videos. Projects covers boilerplates and open-source applications built with Flask, and Hosting lists deployment platforms and WSGI notes. Historical or unmaintained entries are said to live in a separate archived.md file.
use_cases: Finding a Flask extension for authentication, databases, or APIs
Locating Flask tutorials, books, and video courses
Choosing a starter template or boilerplate for a Flask project
Comparing Flask deployment and hosting options
Discovering Flask community channels for help
notable: Organized by category, with extensions grouped into areas such as Auth, Databases, Security and Task Queues
Lists only free tutorials and talks; the README states paid courses are not accepted
Includes boilerplates and open-source Flask applications such as FlaskBB and Apache Superset
Points to a separate archived.md for historical or unmaintained entries
caveats: Entries are link descriptions only; the list does not verify that each linked project is still maintained
Unmaintained or historical entries are moved to a separate archived file
